Aspirations

Aspiration decides a Sim's Wants and Fears. It's picked in the teen years and normally never changes; University lets Sims switch after sophomore year, and Nightlife's ReNuYuSenso Orb can change it any time.

The aspiration meter

Six levels, drawn to scale. Platinum starts at just 35% of capacity.

Deep Redbelow 5%
Mild Red5% to 10%
Lower Green10% to 20%
Upper Green20% to 25%
Gold25% to 35%
Platinum35% and above

Wants fill it, Fears drain it, and it decays every hour except during sleep, work or school. At the bottom the Sim Shrink shows up; the lifetime want grants Perma-platinum.

The 7 main skills

How to train each one, and how many of the 25 career tracks ask for it.

  • Charisma

    Practice speech in a mirror. The Execuputter (Business reward) is the best trainer.

    15 careers
  • Creativity

    Paint at an easel, play the piano, write novels on the computer.

    14 careers
  • Mechanical

    Study at a bookshelf or repair broken things.

    13 careers
  • Logic

    Play chess or look through a telescope.

    13 careers
  • Body

    Work out on exercise equipment or swim.

    10 careers
  • Cleaning

    Study at a bookshelf or clean the house.

    9 careers
  • Cooking

    Study at a bookshelf or cook. Low skill burns food and starts fires.

    5 careers

Boosters: Thinking Cap, Smart Milk, career reward objects (faster than a bookshelf), and with Seasons, fall speeds up every skill.

What each skill does, and why max it

Skills run from 0 to 10. Here's what each one changes in everyday play, and what a Sim gets for reaching the top.

Cooking

Better meals that fill Hunger more, fewer burned dishes and far fewer kitchen fires. New recipes unlock as the skill rises.

Maxed (10/10): Top-quality meals with almost no fire risk, and the skill the Culinary career leans on all the way to Celebrity Chef.

Mechanical

Repairs broken appliances, plumbing and electronics faster, and lowers the odds of getting shocked while fixing them.

Maxed (10/10): Quick repairs that make the repairman unnecessary, and a head start on the Robotics and Toy Making badges (Open for Business). Needed by 13 careers, from Military to Medicine.

Charisma

Makes social interactions like jokes land more often and cuts the chance of being rejected.

Maxed (10/10): Smoother socializing and the top of social careers like Politics, Business and Show Business. With University, 8 points earn a teen the §750 Bain-Gordon Communication Fellowship.

Body

Physical prowess: helps win fights, stay on the dance sphere (Nightlife), and may ease morning sickness during pregnancy.

Maxed (10/10): The edge in every fight and a must for Athletic, Military and Law Enforcement. With University, 8 points already earn a teen the §750 Hogan Award for Athletics.

Logic

Wins chess games and drives promotions in Science, Medicine, Law Enforcement and more.

Maxed (10/10): The best perk of all: at 10, a Sim learns every other skill except Body and Charisma 35% faster. With University, 8 points earn the §750 Will Wright Genius Grant.

Creativity

Instruments sound better and earn bigger tips. At 5 the easel unlocks real painting, including custom paintings with Pets.

Maxed (10/10): Masterpieces that sell for over §500 and bestselling novels written on the computer: a real income from home.

Cleaning

Cleans dirty objects and mops puddles faster. It comes most easily to neat Sims.

Maxed (10/10): Chores take a fraction of the time, freeing hours for needs and wants. With University, 8 points earn the §750 Kim Metro Prize for Hygienics.

  • Any skill at 10 gives a Maximized Skill memory, and maxing a skill is a big aspiration-point want, especially for Knowledge Sims.
  • The top levels of every career ask for several high skills, so maxed skills are what get Sims to their lifetime-want jobs.
  • Maxing all seven at once is a lifetime want of its own, and one of the hardest in the game.

Life skills: what each one teaches

Life skills came with FreeTime (Parenting) and Apartment Life (the other five). A Sim studies them from a bookcase, and unlike the 7 main skills they have no levels: a Sim either knows one or doesn't, and the matching want only counts once it's fully learned.

ParentingFT

Lets a Sim Check on a baby: a thought bubble shows which need (hunger, bladder, energy...) the baby wants met, so no more guessing why it cries.

Family and Knowledge Sims often roll the want to learn it right after a baby arrives.

Fire PreventionAL

Meant to make a Sim panic less when a fire starts, so you can send them to put it out or get away sooner.

Bugged in the shipped game: Sims with it panic just as long. Fan fire mods make it work.

Anger ManagementAL

Lowers the chance of a Sim getting furious with someone. When they do get furious, it wears off faster and hurts the relationship less.

Handy for hot-tempered Sims (few nice points) and busy apartment buildings full of neighbors.

Lifelong HappinessAL

The aspiration bar drains much more slowly, so a Sim stays in gold or platinum far longer between fulfilled wants.

Fewer drops into aspiration failure, and more time to spend points on reward objects.

PhysiologyAL

Builds the Body skill faster, gains fitness faster and loses it more slowly, and drains Energy more slowly.

Bugged with Mansion & Garden Stuff: Body (and the next skills practiced) can jump straight to max. Fix mods exist.

Couples CounselingAL

Unlocks Repair relationship with...: the Sim talks two partners with a romantic problem back together.

Doesn't work on divorced couples, and a Sim can't fix a cheating mess they're part of.

Careers

Every adult career track has 10 levels. To get promoted you need the right skills, enough family friends and a Sim who goes to work in a good mood.

Getting a job

  • The computer shows 5 offers; the newspaper shows 3.
  • The Sim has to be in a good mood to look for work.
  • Computer jobs can start higher, based on skills, friends and degree.
  • Teens and elders get part-time jobs with 3 levels.
  • Teens in private school start at level 2.

Getting promoted

  • With skills and friends in place, Platinum mood virtually guarantees it.
  • A promotion pays the day at the new rate plus 2× the new daily pay.
  • Family friends are friends of anyone in the household (not relatives), counted once.
  • FreeTime: befriend your career's hobby instructor to need one less friend.

Watch out

  • Low performance, a low aspiration meter or lost skill points can mean a demotion.
  • Chance cards give two risky choices; ignoring one has no effect.
  • An elder who retires or quits can never take a full-time job again.
  • University careers are for graduates only.

Adult chance cards

At work, a chance card can pop up with two choices. Each choice can go well or badly, and the game leans toward the honest answer. Pick a career to see the card for every level, with the odds and what each outcome does.

18% chance each workday14% at the top job30% in fall (Seasons)Ignore = no effect

"Best odds" marks the choice more likely to succeed. University careers only have cards on some levels. The wiki doesn't list the odds for FreeTime careers. With FreeTime's Business Instinct aspiration benefit, every choice succeeds 80% of the time.

Declare early

Declare by phone or computer before junior year; Sims won't do it on their own. Anyone still undeclared after sophomore year lands in Philosophy. The "declare a major" want is worth 2,500 points.

Degree perks

Graduates unlock Artist, Natural Scientist, Paranormal and Show Business, and can be hired as high as level 9 from the computer.

Scholarships

Teens apply by phone or computer before leaving for college. Every freshman arrives with §500, and each scholarship won adds to it. A Sim can win as many as they qualify for, so a teen with 8 points in all seven skills, an A, a level 3 job and a past alien abduction starts college with §9,000. College has no tuition, so this is spending money for the first semester.

Neighborhoods

The base game comes with three premade neighborhoods, each with its own soap opera to play out. Every neighborhood works as a separate save.

Pleasantview

25 years after the first The Sims, new faces stir up rivalries between families that used to get along.

  • Goth: Mortimer tries to bounce back after Bella's disappearance; Cassandra is engaged to the town Casanova.
  • Pleasant: Daniel and Mary-Sue's perfect marriage may be a façade.
  • Broke: Brandi raises two boys alone after a "suspicious" pool ladder accident.
  • Caliente: Dina and Nina arrived on the eve of Bella's disappearance.
  • Dreamer and Lothario; in the Family Bin, Burb and Oldie.

Most families start with around §1,000. The Goths, with §511,632, are the rich exception.

Strangetown

A small desert town where abductions, experiments and missing Sims are part of everyday life.

  • Curious: three truth-seeking brothers. One is now expecting an alien baby.
  • Smith: Pollination Technician #9, a retired alien, hopes his son Johnny fits in.
  • Beaker: Loki and Circe experiment on poor Nervous Subject.
  • Grunt: General Buzz runs his sons like a boot camp.
  • Specter: who is buried in Olive's garden? In the Family Bin, Loner and Singles.

The smallest of the three, with 11 lots. Most families already own a career reward object.

Veronaville

The Capps and the Montys have feuded for years, but the young keep crossing the canal and falling in love.

  • Capp: Juliette has fallen for Romeo, golden child of the rival clan.
  • Monty: Patrizio never forgot Consort Capp's broken promise.
  • Summerdream: the neutral family that casts a spell over the town's youth.
  • The Family Bin holds more Capps and Montys ready to move in.

Lots of empty houses and only three families at the start, so there's room for your own story.

Pleasantview's big mystery

Where is Bella Goth?

  • Pleasantview: Bella vanished, leaving Mortimer alone with the kids.
  • The Calientes arrived in town on the very eve of her disappearance.
  • The rumor: she was last seen scaling the deck of Don Lothario's condo.
  • Strangetown: per the wiki, she was abducted by aliens and left there as a townie.
:: Bella speaks: the 2006 interview

Interview with Bella Goth, SimsNetwork, August 3, 2006. Bella vanished in the summer of 2004, and a team of SimCity investigators tracked her down with your questions. Her answers are condensed here in our own words.

Rckljohnson: Where are you now?

Bella: In a place called Strangetown, and believe me, the name fits. I honestly don't know how I got here. I've been seeing a therapist, the hypnotherapy is helping a lot, and I never let my diary out of my sight.

Bbygrl814916: Why don't you have any memories of Mortimer, Cassandra and Alex?

Bella: For months after it happened, all I had was a flash of light. My diary and my therapist are bringing things back little by little. The old days, like Cassandra's birth or my wedding, are still hazy, but I never forgot how much I love my family. I even remember Mortimer's work: he was so close to a permanent life elixir. The temporary one was already a hit all over town.

simgelf: What happened the night you were abducted? Did the saucer crash?

Bella: I dream about being inside some kind of ship, with little green men with huge black eyes. I don't think anything crashed, or I wouldn't be here to tell you. It felt like a moment, and then I was somewhere else entirely.

Simology022: What were you doing on Don Lothario's roof the night you disappeared? And how do you feel about Cassandra and Don?

Bella: Don is misunderstood. He was the new guy, a little too "urban" for the neighbors, and he was lonely, so we made him a friend. That night we were up on his roof under the stars, talking about life and love. Then the flash. I think Cassie had a crush on him from day one, and he may have had a little crush on me. I'm not sure he's right for her, but she should follow her heart. Just don't tell Mortimer I said so!

Chair492: Did you cheat on poor old Morty?

Bella: Of course not! My family is everything to me, and I've never loved anyone the way I love Mortimer. People think he's too brainy to be fun, but at home he's silly and adorable.

poochdog25: Was Dina Caliente in on this? She's related to aliens, she arrived the night you vanished, and now she's after your husband.

Bella: I didn't know about the aliens, but it adds up. Those Caliente sisters were shamelessly forward with my husband, as if I couldn't see it! I think someone sent Dina to pull Mortimer away from me. His elixir matters to a lot of people. Maybe they thought I was a distraction, and that taking me away would make him stop.

simslover210: What about the rumors that you have a double?

Bella: As far as I know, they're not true. Nobody has ever seen the two of us together, so who says it's a double at all? And I'm sure she's not as cute as me.

PprFlwrs4: Why are you still young when your husband is... well, really old?

Bella: I wish I knew. Maybe his research backfired and aged him instead of keeping him young. Or maybe whoever took me tried his formula on me.

WadeSimMiser: What happened when you visited Pollination Technician #9? How would you explain it to Mortimer?

Bella: I've met PT9, and he's lovely! His family has been so kind while I find my feet. I only wish Mortimer could meet him too.

abonnell2000: If you could go back to Mortimer, Cassie and Alex, would you?

Bella: I've been trying! But there's something odd about this town. Every time I try to leave, I somehow end up right back here.

Dixiedawn30: Ever thought about a new hairstyle? And what's with the red dress?

Bella: It works for me, so why change it?

Cheats

Open the console with Ctrl + Shift + C, type the code and press Enter.

Cheat console§ = Simoleons
motherlode

Adds §50,000 to the household.

kaching

Adds §1,000.

familyFunds Goth 50000

Sets a household's funds by last name; + or − adds or subtracts. Max §9,999,999.

aging off

Stops Sims on the lot from aging. aging on turns it back.

boolProp testingCheatsEnabled true

Unlocks Shift-click debug options, like editing needs and relationships.

aspirationLevel 5

Sets the selected Sim's aspiration from 0 (failure) to 5 (Platinum).

moveObjects on

Move and delete anything. A deleted trash can or mailbox never comes back.

boolProp snapObjectsToGrid false

Place objects off the grid. Turn it off again for doors and windows.

intProp maxNumOfVisitingSims 16

Raises the cap on visiting Sims. More Sims, more lag.

slowMotion 4

Slow motion from 0 (normal) to 8, for screenshots and movies.

Pro tips

Served as chance cards, like the ones that pop up while a Sim is at work.

Career

Go Platinum before work

With the skills and friends in place, a Platinum mood virtually guarantees the promotion.

Career

Job hunt on the computer

5 offers instead of 3, and it can hire above level 1. Cheer the Sim up first: a bad mood blocks job hunting.

Friends

Share your friends

Promotions count family friends, so a friend made by anyone in the house helps everyone's career.

Rewards

Gold or bust

Aspiration rewards fail half the time on green and 80% on red. Fill the meter before the Elixir of Life.

Rewards

Lock up the Money Tree

Visitors and NPCs harvest it for themselves. A locked door keeps the §40 harvests at home.

College

Aim for Summa Cum Laude

Honors start your graduate up to 3 levels higher in a matching career.

College

Declare a major

It's a 2,500-point want. Wait too long and the game picks Philosophy for you.

Skills

Use career rewards

They train skills faster than bookshelves, and many Strangetown families already own one.

Elders

Don't retire too soon

Elders can keep climbing in a full-time job, but after retiring only part-time work is left.
